title: The conference USB says “speaker materials”
scenario: After a conference, you find a branded USB drive in your event bag labeled “Speaker Slides + Templates.” Your laptop blocks it and asks whether to allow the device to run setup software.

answers.A: Allow the setup because the USB came inside an official conference bag.
answers.B: Do not run it; obtain materials from the event’s official download site and hand the device to IT/security if required.
answers.C: Open it only on an isolated, security-approved analysis system if your role requires investigation.

explanation: Physical branding and event context can make removable media feel trustworthy. Unknown devices can carry malware or emulate input devices.
proTip: Branded plastic is not a trust certificate.
